title: Join words with a space
description:
Write a function `join_words(words)` that concatenates a list of words into a single string, separated by spaces.

Source items 1-2 (`'Thirty', 'Days', 'Of', 'Python'` and `'Coding', 'For', 'All'`) are the same operation on two different word lists - combined here as one exercise with both as test cases.
hints: ' '.join(words) glues every string in the list together with a single space between each pair - it's a method on the separator string, called with the list as its argument.
Call ' '.join(...) directly on the words list and return the result - no loop needed.
expected_behavior: Returns the words joined into one string, single spaces between them.
explanation: ' '.join(words) is the idiomatic way to combine a list of strings with a fixed separator between them, avoiding a manual loop with string concatenation.
